entities.name: György Kőszegi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: György Kőszegi was a Hungarian weightlifter who competed in the 1976 Summer Olympics and in the 1980 Summer Olympics. He was born in Nyíregyháza. At the 1976 Olympic Games, he won the silver medal.
